requirements.quote: You will then write two artefacts inside a new directory, `/home/user/compliance_audit`:
The file must contain exactly four INI-style sections in the order shown below, each wrapped in square brackets and followed by the key/value pair on the next line.

check.cmd: test "$(grep -E '^\[' /home/user/compliance_audit/performance_report.txt | tr '\n' ' ')" = '[CPU_BENCHMARK] [DISK_IO_BENCHMARK] [MEMORY_BENCHMARK] [SUMMARY] ' && grep -A1 '^\[CPU_BENCHMARK\]$' /home/user/compliance_audit/performance_report.txt | grep -qE '^MaxOperationsPerSec: [0-9]+$' && grep -A1 '^\[DISK_IO_BENCHMARK\]$' /home/user/compliance_audit/performance_report.txt | grep -qE '^AverageLatencyMs: [0-9]+\.[0-9]{2}$' && grep -A1 '^\[MEMORY_BENCHMARK\]$' /home/user/compliance_audit/performance_report.txt | grep -qE '^AvailableMemoryMB: [0-9]+$' && grep -A1 '^\[SUMMARY\]$' /home/user/compliance_audit/performance_report.txt | grep -qE '^Compliant: (YES|NO)$'
